summary: This clinical trial is testing YKYY015 injection in adults with high levels of blood cholesterol who take statin therapy. The study status is Not yet recruiting and plans to enroll 144 participants. Participants will receive either the study drug or a placebo, which is an inactive substance that looks like the drug. The main goal is to measure the percentage change in bad cholesterol levels after 180 days.
